description: Gujarat has introduced a state-wide GPU-as-a-Service framework, giving eligible departments and institutions subsidised access to centralised computing for AI projects.
body_lead: The Gujarat Government has introduced a state-wide GPU-as-a-Service (GPUaaS) framework to boost artificial intelligence (AI) governance and innovation, under the leadership of Chief Minister Bhupendrabhai Patel. The new framework will provide government departments and affiliated institutions with access to shared, centralised high-performance GPU computing resources. This decision, guided by the Chief Minister and led by Science and Technology Minister Arjunbhai Modhwadia, aims to extend AI applications beyond the technology sector into governance, public service delivery, and innovation.
